body.name: Implementation-only outer ATE interval
body.construction: Definitional corollary with no theorem-level credit: set \(C_{\mathrm{ATE}}=[\inf C_L,\sup C_U]\). On the joint endpoint-coverage event, this interval contains the entire sharp set \([L_m(h),U_m(h)]\), so joint endpoint honesty supplies the usual outer-set coverage as an implementation consequence.
